rework_audit.finding: Generated receipt checks successful Comfy history and frame count only, not meaningful motion or continuity. Generic fast-camera prompts and pervasive deterministic push zooms can pass while subjects stay static. Technical decode and frame-change metrics do not certify artistic success.

rebuild_acceptance: Preserve original opening, story motifs, keyframe-first illustrated look, 16:9, original music timing.
Require real subject/environment change in raw unzoomed generated clips; camera motion alone, noise, flicker and cuts do not count.
Review each clip at playback speed and adjacent scenes in context; do not advance dependent scenes until accepted.
Use camera-motion-compensated measurements only as screening, never substitute them for visual review.
Keep recurring characters, environment, scale, palette and action linked across scenes; selected continuity frames within chapters, deliberate reviewed transitions between chapters.
No blanket digital push or speed-up as a fix for failed animation.
Retry with recorded failure-specific changes; repeated failures trigger workflow reassessment, not blind identical retries. Retain takes and provenance.
No paid calls or model downloads newly authorized by this request.
